pages.text: Role: emergency survival utility for high-pressure storm windows.
Mid-to-late recipe cost. Keep a few before elite and boss runs.
$(l)Core Effect$(/l)$(br2)Energy Realm only. Cleanses debuffs, grants resistance and speed for a short burst, then enters cooldown.
$(l)Best Timing$(/l)$(br2)$(li)Surrounded during storm cycle$(li)Pressure is rising too fast$(li)Pre-cast before scripted wave starts
$(l)Notes$(/l)$(br2)$(li)Consumed on use in survival$(li)Prioritize frontline or marked targets$(li)Stacks well with defensive arena tools
